episodes.name: Stark Raving Dad
episodes.overview: A deviation from his norm lands Homer in a mental institution, where he shares a room with a man who thinks he's Michael Jackson.

episodes.name: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
episodes.overview: Lisa's essay wins the Simpsons a trip to Washington, D.C., where her faith in democracy is shaken by her unethical Congressman.

episodes.name: When Flanders Failed
episodes.overview: Flanders suffers a failure after Homer wishes him ill.

episodes.name: Bart the Murderer
episodes.overview: While working for Fat Tony, Bart gains enough influence with his boss to solve his problems with Principal Skinner--perhaps permanently.

episodes.name: Homer Defined
episodes.overview: Homer's averting of a nuclear meltdown earns him employee-of-the-month honors--and a call from Magic Johnson; Milhouse's parents prohibit him from playing with Bart.

episodes.name: Like Father, Like Clown
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa use theological arguments to try to reunite Krusty the Clown and his rabbi father, who disowned Krusty when he turned from rabbi to clown.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror II
episodes.overview: Maggie uses one of three wishes; a mind-reading Bart rules Springfield; Homer donates his brain to Mr. Burns' science project.

episodes.name: Lisa's Pony
episodes.overview: After disappointing Lisa, Homer buys her a pony, solving one problem, but creating others, requiring a second job--at Apu's Kwik-E-Mart.

episodes.name: Saturdays of Thunder
episodes.overview: When Homer helps Bart build a soapbox racer, it does little for the car but a lot for their relationship.

episodes.name: Flaming Moe's
episodes.overview: Moe steals the drink recipe Homer invented, and the rechristened “Flaming Moe” turns his tavern into a hotspot. When a national franchise wants to buy the recipe, Homer wants revenge.

episodes.name: Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
episodes.overview: Burns sells the power plant to a German corporation that doesn't care for Homer's approach to his work.

episodes.name: I Married Marge
episodes.overview: A trip down memory lane to the early days of Simpson wedded bliss, when Marge was with child and Homer was without a job.

episodes.name: Radio Bart
episodes.overview: Bart fools the town into thinking there's a little boy trapped in a well.

episodes.name: Lisa the Greek
episodes.overview: Lisa's ability to pick winning football teams kicks off a strong bond with Homer.

episodes.name: Homer Alone
episodes.overview: A stressed Marge vacations alone, leaving Bart and Lisa with Patty and Selma, and Maggie with Homer--until she leaves in search of Marge.

episodes.name: Bart the Lover
episodes.overview: Bart's answer to detention from Mrs. Krabappel is to answer her personal ad with letters from a Mr. Wonderful, but his last laugh is more of a guilty whimper.

episodes.name: Homer at the Bat
episodes.overview: Burns hires Major League ringers for the plant softball championship.

episodes.name: Separate Vocations
episodes.overview: The results from their aptitude tests cause Bart and Lisa to make 180-degree turns in their behavior.

episodes.name: Dog of Death
episodes.overview: Santa's Little Helper notices resentment after the Simpsons make sacrifices to fund his life-saving operation.

episodes.name: Colonel Homer
episodes.overview: Marge fears a cheatin' heart when a waitress-country singer asks Homer to be her manager.

episodes.name: Black Widower
episodes.overview: Bart suspects something rotten when Selma gets engaged to Sideshow Bob.

episodes.name: The Otto Show
episodes.overview: Spinal Tap hits Springfield, and Otto the bus driver hits the skids after being fired, taking refuge in the Simpsons' garage.

episodes.name: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
episodes.overview: Bart resents Milhouse's new girlfriend; Homer gets the wrong subliminal tape, which has him gaining vocabulary, not losing weight.

episodes.name: Brother, Can You Spare Two Dimes?
episodes.overview: Homer's half-brother asks for a loan after Homer is awarded some cash.
